provenance.relationship: The evidence pack parent is a descendant of the runner commit and contains only the diagnostic pack; this Owner-decision amendment is a later documentation commit and is not a new numerical qualification source.

small_strain_policy.domain: two-cell aspect-6.5 traction model; load factors 1, 1/2, 1/4, 1/8, 1/16; TET4 and HEX8
small_strain_policy.acceptance_rule: The metric must decrease toward zero across the declared load-reduction series with stable converged solves; no universal scalar error threshold is claimed.
small_strain_policy.rationale: Both families exhibit the expected first-order small-load asymptotic trend over the tested domain.

tangent_fd_policy.metric: relative norm of analytic tangent action versus centered finite-difference action
tangent_fd_policy.near_zero_rule: Retain the existing denominator floor; where the FD reference norm is at or below that floor, report the absolute residual and do not issue a relative PASS.
tangent_fd_policy.rationale: The proposed band is about 21 times above the worst observed envelope while remaining below the round-off-dominated study endpoint; six states, three directions and both families are covered.

mesh_policy.TET4: Flexion/shear sensitivity documented across four levels; no universal convergence claim.
mesh_policy.HEX8: Flexion/shear sensitivity documented across four levels; reaction trend is more stable than displacement in this study.
mesh_policy.owner_action: Confirm whether this bounded limitation is acceptable for the intended TL domain.

external_correlation_policy.reason: Code_Aster and CalculiX executables were unavailable; no exact comparable case was executed.
external_correlation_policy.rule: G07-TL-008 remains required before TL promotion; a skip is never PASS.

qualified_bounded_domain_recommended: Internal TL elasticity observations for TET4/HEX8 over the declared small-strain, tangent-FD, rotation and four-level flexion/shear study domains only.
limitations: No universal mesh or aspect-ratio threshold.
No external or physical validation claim from the skipped campaign.
G07 remains open and TL promotion is deferred until comparable external evidence is available.
